plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.

conservative.read: This plan aims for modest gains around 1.5% per month by focusing on capital preservation. The risk is low drawdown, but upside is also limited.

balanced.read: This balanced approach targets around 2.5% monthly growth while prioritizing risk management. Drawdowns should be moderate, but significant upside is also tempered.
